quotations.old_english: Ongunnon hí ðæt apostolíce líf ðære frymþelícan cyricean onhýrigean
quotations.latin: cœpérunt apostolícam prímitívæ ecclésiæ vítam imitári

source_text: frymþelíc; adj. [frymþ a beginning] Primitive, first; pr&i-long;m&i-short;t&i-long;vus :-- Ongunnon hí ðæt apostolíce líf ðære frymþelícan cyricean onhýrigean cœpérunt apost&o-short;l&i-short;cam pr&i-long;m&i-short;t&i-long;væ eccl&e-long;siæ v&i-long;tam im&i-short;t&a-long;ri, Bd. 1, 26; S. 487, 32: 4, 23; S. 593, 41. On frymþelícum synne originali peccato, Rtl. 101, 20. Of ðam frymþlícan from the original, Blickl. Homl. 107, 5.
